project_info.theme: Hero product shot for Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Soft Peach Pink, White, Matte Black, Gold, Lotus Pink

main_subject.detail: A clean hero poster centered on a Cocoon Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid bottle with SPF 50+ label, framed by a translucent glass vessel containing a pink lotus bud on the left and a curved glass edge in the lower right.
main_subject.style: Minimal premium skincare hero photography, airy launch visual, elegant prop styling

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'SỮA CHỐNG NẮNG VÔ CƠ SEN HẬU GIANG' and product label text 'Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid', 'SPF 50+ QUANG PHỔ RỘNG BROAD SPECTRUM PA++++', and 'TONE-UP BEIGE'.
items: Top Left: Large white product-name headline on the blue gradient background.
Top Right: Open sky-blue negative space continuing the clean hero layout.
Bottom Left: Glass vessel edge with water bubbles and a pink lotus bud partially submerged or leaning inside.
Bottom Right: Curved translucent glass line entering from the corner, echoing the premium prop styling.
Center/Background: White sunscreen bottle upright in the center with black cap and gold logo, against the blue-to-peach gradient.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean bottle highlights, gentle glass reflections, airy freshness, premium launch clarity

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity beauty product hero photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a skincare hero launch shot. Centerpiece is a Cocoon Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid bottle standing upright with visible SPF 50+ and tone-up beige labeling. Background is a blue-to-soft-peach gradient. Surrounding elements: large headline 'SỮA CHỐNG NẮNG VÔ CƠ SEN HẬU GIANG', a translucent glass vessel with a pink lotus bud and water bubbles on the left, and a curved glass edge in the lower right. Keep the airy premium hero composition and clean packshot fidelity. Technical style: high fidelity beauty product hero photography, soft studio beauty lighting, clean bottle highlights and gentle glass reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
